bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks are not allowed. Small bags under 12 inches are allowed and will be searched before entry.
bagPolicy.quote: NO BACKPACKS. You may bring small bags under 12 inches and they will be searched.

parking.summary: The closest parking is the Underground Atlanta parking deck, run by Legacy Parking Solutions. Use 75 Martin Luther King Jr Dr SW in your GPS and look for the purple 75 MLK sign on the deck. From the deck, you enter Kenny's Alley and The Masquerade through the breezeway on Level 3.
parking.quote: Closest parking is located in the Underground Atlanta parking deck owned by Legacy Parking Solutions.

rideshare.summary: For rideshare, taxi and drop-off, use 92 Pryor St SW. The Pryor Street entrance to Kenny's Alley is on the left side of the road; walk through the archway and down three flights of stairs.
rideshare.quote: ADDRESS TO USE: 92 PRYOR ST. SW

concessions.summary: Food is sold at a walk-up window in the courtyard next to Altar, and its schedule varies, so check the venue's pinned social post. Payment is cash, Visa or Mastercard; AMEX and Discover are not accepted. Outside food and drinks and reusable water bottles are not allowed.
concessions.quote: Ordering takes place at a walk up window in the courtyard next to Altar.

accessibility.summary: The Masquerade is wheelchair accessible. If you need wheelchair assistance, speak with a member of Masquerade staff.
accessibility.quote: Yes we are. For those needing wheelchair assistance, please speak with a member of Masquerade Staff.

reEntry.summary: The Masquerade hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: The weekday box office is in Kenny's Alley with the Heaven, Hell, Purgatory and Altar rooms, open 10:00 a.m. to 6:30 p.m. Monday through Friday, and takes cash, Visa and Mastercard. Scanners read tickets from your phone on show night, and artist and media lists are at the venue door when doors open.
ticketPickup.quote: The week day box office is located in Kenny's Alley along with the Heaven, Hell, Purgatory, and Altar performance spaces.

gates.summary: Door time is listed on the website and on your ticket, and music starts 30 minutes to 1 hour after doors. Will Call is at the entrance to each room. For 18+ and 21+ shows, bring a valid government-issued physical photo ID.
gates.quote: Music starts 30 minutes to 1 hour after doors, subject to change at Artist's discretion.
